records.question: Tickets tagged outage by month
records.sql: SELECT substr(t0."opened_ts",1,7) AS "month", COUNT(*) AS "row_count" FROM "tickets" AS t0 WHERE (EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM "ticket_tags" AS x0_0 WHERE x0_0."ticket_id" = t0."ticket_id" AND x0_0."tag" IN ('outage'))) GROUP BY substr(t0."opened_ts",1,7) ORDER BY "month"

records.sql: SELECT SUM(t0."reopen_cnt") AS "sum_reopen_cnt" FROM "tickets" AS t0 LEFT JOIN "accounts" AS j1 ON j1."acct_id" = t0."acct_id" WHERE (j1."tier" IN ('Silver'))
